shipped_numerics.explanation: two generation runs of the same trained bank on the same expert and the same rows are not bitwise-guaranteed; the source of the observed same-expert text differences is unknown. One unverified hypothesis is micro-batch-composition-dependent bf16 rounding of near-tied greedy tokens (readout_model.py generate(), run.py routed_predictions grouping); counts are exact, causal attribution is not established.
shipped_numerics.consequence: same-expert rows may contribute nonzero (c_native - c_oracle) even when they are routed to their own expert in both variants; pool-level subgroup statistics are therefore unidentifiable whenever any same-expert row differs, and the exact selected-group mean is retained only for eligible cells (0 own-route text mismatches).
